caption: A quarter-turn made on top of a leftover fold now re-forms in place. An undisciplined Infantry block snaps onto its first move order, which leaves its grid folded off its heading. After it halts, E quarter-turns it, adding the drill's 90 degrees to that fold. The next move order re-squares the grid, and because a quarter-turn drill made the fold, each man is re-paired to the nearest new cell, so the block re-forms where it stands. Before, the composed fold was not a quarter, the re-pair was skipped, and most of the men walked through each other to cells on the far side of the block.
